name: PDSls
description: AT Protocol utilities — search users, resolve identities, view PLC logs and lexicons via pds.ls
readme:
AT Protocol utilities for Alfred, integrating with pds.ls.

Keywords:
  pdsearch {query}   Search Bluesky profiles
  pdresolve {query}  Resolve a DID or handle
  pdplc {query}      View the PLC operation log for a did:plc
  pdlex {nsid}       View a lexicon schema (e.g. app.bsky.feed.post)

Actions on any result: ⏎ open in pds.ls · ⌘ copy DID/JSON · ⌥ copy secondary · ⇧ Quick Look detail.

Requires Node.js on PATH (Homebrew /opt/homebrew/bin or nvm are auto-detected).

config.script:
export PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$HOME/.nvm/current/bin:$PATH"
command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || export PATH="$(ls -d "$HOME"/.nvm/versions/node/*/bin 2>/dev/null | tail -1):$PATH"
exec node "./dist/search.cjs" "$1"
config.subtext: Search Bluesky profiles and open in PDSls
config.title: Search Users
